entries.zh: 行人：朝廷使臣，明代行人司官员（奉命出差、传宣诏命的官职）；亦泛指出行之人
entries.en: an office at the (Mandarin) court: imperial envoy/courier, an official of the Court of the Messengers sent on missions
entries.notes: 词头处标注词性存疑（vt/vn）；据汉字「行人」与西语「朝廷官职」互证为明制行人司奉使之官，官话栏空。

entries.zh: 礼科：礼科给事中（明代六科之一，稽察礼仪、祭祀、科举等），地位较高的京官职衔
entries.en: the Office of Rites (one of the Six Offices of Scrutiny): a ranked mandarin post overseeing rites, sacrifices and examinations

entries.zh: 伎俩：技能、本领；足以应付各种行当的谋生手艺；亦指手段、花招
entries.en: skill, ability, craft; universal knack for any trade; also trick, cunning device

entries.zh: 土師傅：手艺粗浅的匠师，做粗活（土工）的工匠
entries.en: a workman of rough (coarse) work; an inferior or rustic master-craftsman (shifu)
entries.notes: 末字原稿疑为皂/傅，据闽音 hû 判作傅（師傅）；官话栏空。

entries.zh: 一流工匠、精于其艺的师傅（X工師傅：首字疑为切/句，末字疑为皂/傅）
entries.en: a first-rate master workman, skilled in his craft
entries.notes: 首字与末字均存疑（切/句、皂/傅），据闽音 chi-cāng-sāy-hû 与西语「技艺中第一等工匠」释义，官话栏空。

entries.zh: 精巧：精细巧妙；技艺精湛
entries.en: exquisite, ingenious; finely and skilfully made

entries.zh: 粗師傅：粗工，做粗重活计的匠师；手艺粗劣的工匠
entries.en: a workman of coarse/rough work; an unrefined artisan
entries.notes: 末字原稿疑为皂/傅，据闽音 hû 判作傅；官话栏空。

entries.zh: 拙手：手笨、笨拙（的人）；做工粗笨不巧
entries.en: clumsy-handed, unskilful; a bungler

entries.zh: 送：献上、进献；献祭（物品）
entries.en: to offer, present; to sacrifice (something)

entries.zh: 祀：祭祀、祭献
entries.en: to sacrifice; sacrificial rite
entries.notes: 西语词条「Ofrecer la」截断且闽音栏一处 T99 污損难辨，据汉字祀与闽音 sū 定祭祀义，官话栏空。

entries.zh: 儀：行礼、献仪（礼仪性奉献）；亦指礼金礼物
entries.en: to make a ritual/ceremonial offering; rite, ceremonial gift
entries.notes: 西语词条截断，闽音栏混入赘迹（sacrificarli），据汉字儀并参同页第14条互证释义，官话栏空。

entries.zh: 牲（字形疑为幸/牲）：献祭用的牺牲、祭品
entries.en: sacrificial animal/victim; to offer in sacrifice
entries.notes: 原稿字形存疑（幸/牲）：闽音 heng 近幸，而西语义献祭合牲，从牲释义，官话栏空。

entries.zh: 祭：祭祀、祭献（祭神明或亡灵）
entries.en: to sacrifice; to offer sacrifice (to gods or the dead)

entries.zh: 儀：致送礼金、贺仪；礼貌性馈赠
entries.en: to offer a courtesy present; a ceremonial gift (of money)

entries.zh: 中秋：中秋节（农历八月十五），有祭月献祭之俗
entries.en: the Mid-Autumn Festival (15th day of the 8th lunar month), when offerings/sacrifices are made
entries.notes: 西文此条系于八月十四（a los 14 de la luna de agosto），与中秋常例八月十五不合，或为原稿记误。

entries.zh: 送神：祭送神明上天（焚化纸马香烛送神，常于岁末送灶时行之）
entries.en: to send off the god(s) with sacrifice; the rite of dispatching the deity back to heaven
entries.notes: 西文系于八月十四（luna octava），与送神常例（岁末十二月廿四送灶送神）不合，或原稿记误；汉字与闽音清晰互证。

entries.zh: 送尫上天：焚送神像（尫，神偶）上天；岁末祭送神明回天的仪式
entries.en: to send the god('s image/effigy) up to heaven; rite of dispatching the deity heavenward with burnt offerings
entries.notes: 西语释文「por el mes mo'tiempo」文字残混难解，据汉字与闽音清晰互证释义。

entries.zh: 宣奠：奠祭亡者，设奠献祭于死者
entries.en: to offer sacrifice to the dead; to lay funerary offerings

entries.zh: 充：充当、自任；自告奋勇去做某事
entries.en: to offer oneself (to do something); to serve as, fill (a role)

entries.zh: 充場：凑数顶场、自愿充当补位
entries.en: to fill a place or make up the number; to come forward as a stand-in
